name: clawd-view
description: A calm, plain-English view of Claude Code: a step-by-step checklist above the prompt, usage stats when there's room, and Clawd the pixel mascot acting out each step. Tool calls and commands stay out of sight.

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: Language of the captions beside Clawd. auto follows your locale (LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG): Chinese for zh_*, English otherwise. 小人旁边文字的语言,auto 跟随系统 locale。

chatModel.title: Chat model / 聊天模型
chatModel.description: Which model answers when you chat with Clawd (/clawd chat, or switch with /clawd model). haiku, sonnet or opus get a copy of your conversation with Claude so far (the newest 40,000 characters or so); main forks the session's own conversation on its own model, with nothing cut. 和 Clawd 聊天时用哪个模型(也可以用 /clawd model 切换):haiku/sonnet/opus 会拿到你和 Claude 到目前为止的对话副本(最新的约 4 万字);main 分叉主会话,用主会话的模型,完整不截。

chatEffort.title: Chat effort / 聊天思考强度
chatEffort.description: How hard the chat model thinks before Clawd answers (/clawd effort). default leaves it to the model; models without an effort setting ignore it, and main uses the session's own. 和 Clawd 聊天时模型的思考强度:default 交给模型自己决定;不支持的模型会忽略,main 沿用主会话的设置。
